exposure: human milk (HM) macronutrients and energy content
Stage of lactation (colostrum vs. mature milk)
cohort: Mothers of 157 healthy term infants (92 female, 65 male)
finding: Macronutrients and energy content in colostrum and mature milk collected from mothers of term infants were not affected by the sex of their offspring.
birth_weight: Male infants: 3389.5 ± 444.6 g, Female infants: 3229.2 ± 415 g
